en: A Soviet-era aviation postcard featuring an illustration of a modernist waterfront building with moored sailboats, described as an Olympic sailing center. Decorative elements include a stylized torch and ribbon. On the upper right is a printed stamp design for the XXII Olympic Games with Olympic rings and a stadium or venue plan, marked with a denomination of 4 kopeks and the text 'ПОЧТА СССР 1980 К'. The right side has preprinted address lines and index boxes in Russian for the sender and recipient.
